description: Vendor-neutral release questions for RAG, agents, voice, cost, safety, and human approval.
judge_policy: Deterministic checks first; calibrated judge second; named human owns the release decision.

items.question: Can every citation resolve to an indexed source?
Does the agent stop at its iteration budget?
Can a tool error be corrected without inventing a result?
Are quality, latency, and cost measured together?
Can the deployment return to the previous known-good configuration?
Does voice testing isolate STT, LLM/tools, TTS, and transport?
Did the judge agree with calibrated humans on a held-out set?
Are source freshness and provider model changes treated as release-sensitive?
